intro:
Experience the whole flow guided step by step,
from asking the AI to running a Movement and checking the results.
greeting:
Hello. This is the Exastro AI assistant.
How can I help you?

steps.text: Install nginx on the 3 web servers and start it.
steps.guide: Click the input field. Type what you want the AI to do in everyday language.
Press the send button to send your request to the AI.

steps.text: Understood. I'll look for Movements that can install and start nginx.
I found 2 Movements related to nginx. Which one would you like to use?
steps.guide: The AI has suggested candidates. This time, choose "nginx_install".

steps.text: I've identified the target hosts. Please select the Operation to use.
steps.guide: Choose the target of the work (Operation). Select "Web_Build_2026".

steps.text:
I will run it with the following settings. Is that OK?

- **Movement**: nginx_install (Ansible Legacy)
- **Operation**: Web_Build_2026
- **Target hosts**: web01, web02, web03
steps.guide: You can review the details before running. Press "Run" to execute the Movement.

steps.name: nginx_install
steps.guide: The execution status of the Movement is shown in real time. Please wait until it completes. While it is running, you can also stop it with "Emergency stop".

steps.text:
Emergency stop received. The Movement execution has been stopped.

- **web01**: nginx installation was completed
- **web02**: stopped during installation
- **web03**: not yet executed

You can check the state at the time of the stop from "Check the work status".

steps.guide: From "Check the work status", you can see how far the process had progressed.

steps.text:
That's the end of the demo.
Even work delegated to the AI can be stopped at any time from Exastro,
and you can check its state at the moment it was stopped.

The Movement execution has completed.

- **web01**: nginx 1.26 installed and started
- **web02**: nginx 1.26 installed and started
- **web03**: nginx 1.26 installed and started

You can download the detailed logs from "Result data".

steps.guide: From "Result data", you can check details such as the execution log.

steps.text:
That's the end of the demo.
The AI supports you from a natural-language request
through Movement execution and result checking.
